title: Machete Maidens Unleashed!
short_description: 2010 Australian documentary film by Mark Hartley

Production companies: Melbourne International Film Festival Premiere Fund

production_companies: Melbourne International Film Festival Premiere Fund

text.lead: Machete Maidens Unleashed! is a 2010 Australian documentary film directed by Mark Hartley.
text.plot: The documentary explores exploitation films made in the Philippines in the 1970s and 1980s with interviews for the documentary include Allan Arkush, Judy Brown, Colleen Camp, Roger Corman, Joe Dante, Pam Grier, Jack Hill, John Landis, Danny Peary, Eddie Romero, Cirio H. Santiago, and Brian Trenchard-Smith.
text.reception: The film was met with critical acclaim as it has an 88% rating on Rotten Tomatoes.
